reason: Delivered three generic ng-zorro-era capabilities in @versionless/angular plus shared binding-resolution helpers. (1) Peer-hole detection reads undeclared runtime edges from an installed closure's own manifests and analyzer-parsed bundles, declaring them at the cell's registry-verified range and refusing when the cell read no line. (2) An exports-map resolver blocks/rewrites style imports to the mechanically identified root aggregate, removing redundant granular imports, all through declaredDifferences with measured bytes; refuses when no aggregate exists. (3) A cross-module modal migration renames nzComponentParams to nzData and binding-resolves each nzContent class to inject NZ_MODAL_DATA for exactly the supplied fields, all-or-nothing per call. 41 new tests. Fact-checked read-only against the staged closure: 0 modal refusals, 9 style imports collapsed (152717->550342 bytes), @ctrl/tinycolor@^4.2.0 declared. No closure writes, no builds, nothing committed.
